status: Prepared question set; not a completed AI-answer or citation baseline
procedure: Run the same questions against ordinary archive search and graph-assisted retrieval. Record platform/model/date, prompts and tool access, source URLs found, exact citations, attribution errors, unsupported conclusions and preservation of distinct perspectives. Human/editorial relevance judgements are needed; unit tests and lexical match scores are not answer-quality measurements.

questions.question: How do persistent agents retain useful context between sessions?
questions.reviewFocus: Distinguish persistent operational work from personal learning or news graphs.

questions.question: What should remain under human review when agents do the work?
questions.reviewFocus: Preserve the scope and consequences of each source's review proposal.

questions.question: Why might agents use code rather than operate a graphical interface?
questions.reviewFocus: Keep interface and mature-tool tradeoffs; do not claim a universal best approach.

questions.question: How can people and agents share a work record without losing context?
questions.reviewFocus: Separate source records, collaboration layers and UI choices.

questions.question: What limits the number of agents one person can supervise?
questions.reviewFocus: Distinguish arguments about human attention from measured capacity limits.

questions.question: How can an agent's authority be bounded?
questions.reviewFocus: Attribute proposals and examples without asserting untested security guarantees.

questions.question: Does a more intelligent model always produce a more useful result?
questions.reviewFocus: Preserve differing tasks and operating constraints.

questions.question: How does a visual map help people and agents understand a system together?
questions.reviewFocus: Keep diagrams, code schematics and task trees distinct.

questions.question: How should a business test an AI idea before committing to a large build?
questions.reviewFocus: Distinguish source suggestions from universal business or financial advice.

questions.question: How do agents change the value of operational knowledge?
questions.reviewFocus: Attribute ownership and transferability arguments to their sources.

questions.question: What changes when generating content becomes cheap?
questions.reviewFocus: Preserve the separate claims about trust, distribution and craft.

questions.question: Where do convenience and private control pull in different directions?
questions.reviewFocus: Retain different product and deployment contexts.

visibilityBaseline.requires: Authorised Search Console/Bing Webmaster Tools access, crawl logs and referral/conversion analytics; public deployment alone is not indexing or citation evidence.
